headlines.title: U.S.-China trade truce extended for two months, Bessent says, as Xi begins state visit
headlines.summary: The deal, which was set to expire in November, will now be extended to Jan. 10, Bessent said, noting the need for Beijing to fulfill more deliverables.

headlines.title: The timely tax strategy that can help bond investors make the best of runaway yields and big losses
headlines.summary: Runaway treasury yields and the bond market selloff create sizable tax-loss harvesting trades for investors to offset big gains from stocks.

headlines.title: Meta is trying VR glasses (again), this time with more IMAX
headlines.summary: Meta's return to the VR glasses realm comes with a promising combination of light weight form factor and enhanced entertainment options.

headlines.title: Meta introduces camera-free AI glasses
headlines.summary: Meta says the camera-free glasses will be lighter and have up to 12 hours battery life.

headlines.title: Meta's standoff with Amazon over Muse could be a sign of things to come
headlines.summary: Meta's new Muse AI personal agent is garnering excitement and shows signs of becoming a hit, but Amazon has blocked the app from its site.

headlines.title: Vogue sent robots down the runway at Vogue World, and people were not impressed
headlines.summary: Nothing says Italian craftsmanship like a Chinese robot doing a lasso to "L'Amour Toujours."

headlines.title: ‘It doesn’t seem fair’: I’m retired and have plenty of money. Why can’t I qualify for a retail credit card?
headlines.summary: “I draw from my IRA as needed for household repairs, trips and other larger expenses.”

headlines.title: Anthropic says its biology lab has already found something big
headlines.summary: But maybe the biggest reveal is that Anthropic has not let Claude run loose in its biology lab. Humans are still, so far, in the loop.

headlines.title: Social Security overpaid my 82-year-old mother by $20,000. What else is hiding in her finances?
headlines.summary: “My mother has a pension, Social Security, investments and a house probably worth over $1 million.”

headlines.title: ‘I don’t begrudge them their money’: My husband and I have friends who spend, spend, spend. How do we keep up?
headlines.summary: “A weekend away isn’t a weekend away. It’s a luxury hotel, expensive meals and a last-minute upgrade.”

headlines.title: This test screens for 50 cancers — but whether Medicare and other health insurers will cover it hinges on FDA approval
headlines.summary: Grail’s Galleri test looks for 50 cancers from a blood draw, but a major study failed to prove it could detect later-stage cancers.

headlines.title: Micron’s stock has become a ‘battleground’ as the AI narrative shifts
headlines.summary: Investors have become more focused on the durability of memory-chip demand, but there are reasons to be optimistic on that front, a UBS analyst said.
